metadata.suite: Project Rakshak 2.0 Multi-Temporal Change Detection Benchmark
metadata.coregistration_method: ORB (2500 kp) + RANSAC Affine with Phase Correlation Fallback
metadata.stability_filter_rule: Report change only if conf >= 0.40 in appearing scene AND no detection of same class within 28px in partner scene at conf >= 0.15
metadata.operational_isolation: Strictly isolated from operational threat scoring table

detector_flicker_unchanged.description: Detector flicker on unedited objects present in both scenes (partner conf below 0.25 floor)

inpainting_artifacts.description: Hallucinated detections at inpainting patch boundaries where objects were removed or moved

misregistration_texture_noise.description: Residual sub-pixel displacement noise and unassociated background textures

honest_failure_analysis: 1. Detector Flicker on Unchanged Objects (63.64% of FPs): Targets present in both scenes with marginal detection confidence (~0.20-0.30) are detected in one epoch but pruned in the partner epoch, creating 49 false-positive change alerts in raw mode.

2. Inpainting Boundary Artifacts (31.17% of FPs): Telea inpainting on complex tarmac or vegetation occasionally leaves boundary texture transitions that trigger spurious post-scene detections (24 false positives).

3. Operational Trade-Off with Stability Filter: The stability filter prunes 76 of 77 False Positives, increasing pooled precision from 23.76% (31.17% mean) to 87.50% (32.50% mean), but reduces recall from 40.00% to 11.67% because low-confidence genuine changes are suppressed.
4. Sub-Pixel Co-Registration Resilience: Across misalignments up to 8.0 px, mean registration error remains 0.1887 ± 0.1350 px, showing negligible mis-registration FP contribution (5.19%).
